Shatter +12: This effect gives a +12 Enhancement bonus to the DC to resist the character's Sunder and Improved Sunder attempts.
Insightful Will Save +2: This item gives a +2 Insight bonus to your Will saves.
Immunity to Fear: The wearer of this item is immune to all fear effects.
Strength +11: This item gives the wearer the power of Ogre Strength, granting a +11 Enhancement bonus to Strength.
Tendon Slice 6%: This effect gives a 6% chance to Hamstring the target for each attack that does damage.
